milestone.title: Q3 2026 Release
milestone.description: Ship core features for Project X v1.0 by end of Q3.

issues.title: Define Project X goals and success metrics
issues.body: We need to define clear goals for Project X: ship the data pipeline, launch the dashboard, and onboard 3 pilot customers by end of Q3.

comments.author: pm-alice
comments.body: Agreed. Top priority is the data pipeline — everything else depends on it.

issues.title: Build data ingestion pipeline
issues.body: Implement the core data ingestion pipeline that reads from source APIs and writes to the data warehouse.

comments.author: dev-bob
comments.body: Hit a rate-limit issue with the source API. Implementing exponential backoff.

issues.title: Dashboard not loading for large datasets
issues.body: When datasets exceed 10k rows the dashboard times out. This is blocking the pilot customer onboarding.

comments.author: dev-carol
comments.body: Root cause: the frontend is fetching all rows at once. Need server-side pagination.

comments.author: pm-alice
comments.body: This is a blocker for the pilot. Prioritize this over new features.

issues.title: Pilot customer onboarding delayed
issues.body: Cannot onboard pilot customers until the dashboard performance issue (#3) is resolved. Deadline at risk.

comments.author: pm-alice
comments.body: Moved the pilot onboarding target from Sept 15 to Sept 25. If #3 isn't fixed by Sept 20, we miss Q3.

issues.title: Add user authentication to dashboard
issues.body: Implement OAuth2 login for the dashboard so we can scope data access per customer.

pull_requests.title: feat: implement data ingestion pipeline
pull_requests.body: Implements the core data pipeline with backoff and retry logic.

review_comments.author: dev-carol
review_comments.body: Looks solid. One concern: we're not handling schema drift. If the source API changes its response format, the pipeline will silently drop fields.

pull_requests.title: feat: add OAuth2 authentication
pull_requests.body: Adds OAuth2 login flow using Auth0. Scoped data access per customer org.

review_comments.author: dev-bob
review_comments.body: Works well. We should add refresh token rotation before going to prod — current implementation stores tokens in localStorage.

pull_requests.title: fix: add server-side pagination to dashboard API
pull_requests.body: Adds cursor-based pagination to the /data endpoint. Should resolve the timeout issue for large datasets.

review_comments.author: pm-alice
review_comments.body: This is our highest-priority fix. Please get it merged before Sept 20.

commits.message: fix: add cursor-based pagination to /data endpoint
commits.author: dev-carol
